def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

def parse_pair(text, n):
    head=re.search(rf'Demo pair {n} input \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',text)
    H,W=map(int,head.groups()); pos=head.end()
    nextout=text.index(f'Demo pair {n} output',pos)
    inpstr=text[pos:nextout].strip()
    outhead=re.search(rf'Demo pair {n} output \({H}x{W}\):\n',text)
    ostart=outhead.end()
    end=text.find('\n\nSame instance.',ostart)
    outstr=text[ostart:end if end>=0 else len(text)].strip()
    def grid(s):
        rows=[[int(x) for x in ln.split()] for ln in s.splitlines() if ln.strip() and all(t.isdigit() for t in ln.split())]
        assert len(rows)==H and all(len(row)==W for row in rows),(len(rows),[len(x) for x in rows])
        return rows
    return grid(inpstr),grid(outstr)
